title: Desenvolvimento Java AWS - Pleno - 124105
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

  • Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Business Analyst (BA) Sênior | Foco em ERP
description:
Business Analyst (BA) Sênior | Foco em ERP


Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto (cliente base EUA) | Contratação: PJ


A Mouts busca um(a) Business Analyst (BA) Sênior para atuar em um cliente estratégico com base nos Estados Unidos. Essa posição é para quem já viveu implantações grandes de ERP , tem visão de negócio , ótima capacidade analítica e consegue atuar como ponte entre áreas, em um ambiente global e de alta complexidade.


Responsabilidades

– Conduzir levantamento e mapeamento de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais

– Atuar em implantações, rollouts ou transformações de sistemas ERP

– Mapear e redesenhar processos de negócio (AS-IS / TO-BE)

– Elaborar documentação funcional (BRD, FRD, user stories, fluxos, etc.)

– Facilitar workshops com áreas de negócio e times técnicos

– Apoiar testes funcionais (SIT, UAT) e validação das entregas

– Garantir alinhamento entre requisitos, escopo e objetivos estratégicos

– Atuar como elo entre stakeholders nos EUA e times técnicos


Requisitos

– Experiência sólida como BA em projetos de grande porte

– Vivência comprovada em implantações de ERP

– Experiência com mapeamento e otimização de processos

– Inglês avançado/fluente (mandatório)

– Experiência em ambientes multiculturais

– Forte capacidade analítica e comunicação com diferentes níveis (inclusive executivo)


Diferenciais

– Experiência em projetos globais/multinacionais

– Certificações (CBAP, PMI-PBA ou similares)

– Metodologias ágeis e/ou híbridas

– Passaporte válido, visto americano e disponibilidade para viagens internacionais

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

description:

title: Assistente administrativo de coordenação de eventos
description:
Descrição da Empresa Sugerimos que insira os detalhes aqui.

Descrição do Cargo Buscamos um Assistente Administrativo de Coordenação de Eventos para integrar nossa equipe em regime remoto. As principais responsabilidades incluem apoiar a organização e execução de eventos, garantir a comunicação eficaz entre os participantes e fornecedores e acompanhar todas as etapas necessárias para o sucesso dos eventos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral voltado para pessoas organizadas e proativas, com habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas.

Qualificações

  • Planejamento e Gerenciamento de Eventos : Experiência em planejamento e execução de eventos, incluindo organização de logísticas e resolução de problemas em tempo hábil.
  • Comunicação e Organização: Habilidade para se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com equipes internas, fornecedores e clientes. Organização de documentos, planilhas, informações e grupos de comunicação
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Capacidade de fornecer excelente atendimento ao cliente, assegurando a satisfação e suportando suas necessidades.
  • Competências adicionais, como experiência com ferramentas de organização de eventos e proficiência em idiomas estrangeiros, serão diferenciais importantes.

title: Tech Lead Hands-on (Microsoft Stack)
description:
Tech Lead Hands-on (Microsoft Stack)


Sobre a vaga:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Hands-on com sólida bagagem técnica e experiência no ecossistema Microsoft, para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções de IA, automação e produtividade em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador.


Essa posição combina liderança técnica e atuação prática em código , com foco em prototipar MVPs , garantir boas práticas de engenharia e impulsionar o uso de tecnologias Microsoft como Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint e Databricks .


A atuação é 100% remota , mas seria um diferencial profissionais com disponibilidade para encontros presenciais em Guarulhos – SP, uma vez por semana .

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente times multidisciplinares no desenho e execução de soluções em nuvem e IA.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on , participando ativamente de análises, codificação e revisão de código.
  • Prototipar e desenvolver MVPs (Minimum Viable Products) para validação e aceleração de entregas.
  • Utilizar a Microsoft Suite completa (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint) na criação de soluções integradas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de dados e negócio para identificar oportunidades de automação e eficiência.
  • Garantir qualidade técnica, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções construídas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead , Engenheiro(a) de Software ou Arquiteto(a) de Soluções , com atuação prática em desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Azure Cloud (preferencialmente AI e Data Services).
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry e Copilot Studio .
  • Domínio em Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint).
  • Vivência com Databricks e integração de dados e APIs.
  • Capacidade de construir e evoluir provas de conceito e MVPs funcionais .
  • Forte base em engenharia de software (versionamento, testes, pipelines de CI/CD, boas práticas).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com IA generativa e copilots personalizados .
  • Vivência com MLOps , DataOps ou automação inteligente.
  • Experiência em Projetos corporativos de transformação digital .
  • Inglês técnico para leitura, documentação e acompanhamento de roadmaps de produto.
  • Disponibilidade para presença semanal em Guarulhos – SP .

Perfil esperado:

  • Profissional com visão sistêmica e perfil de liderança técnica , capaz de unir estratégia e execução.
  • Autonomia e proatividade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e em evolução constante.
  • Paixão por tecnologia Microsoft e inovação com IA.
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração e clareza ao traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Desenvolvedor Fullstack - Remoto.

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.

title: Facial Action Coding Specialist – FACS Certified(remote)
description:
Company Description

Huzzle is a platform dedicated to connecting world-class experts with AI labs and enterprises. Leveraging an innovative AI recruiter, Huzzle provides seamless sourcing, in-depth vetting, and targeted training for large volumes of talent. Known for maintaining consistently high-quality services, Huzzle partners with organisations to match the best experts to their needs. Join our mission to empower businesses in unlocking their potential through top-tier talent and AI-driven solutions.


Location: Remote

Contract Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Start: ASAP

Pay: $20–$30/hr


Role Description

This is a remote, short-term freelance contract role for a Facial Action Coding Specialist – FACS Certified. The specialist will analyse facial expressions using the Facial Action Coding System (FACS) to identify and document emotional and facial actions accurately. Responsibilities may include examining video content, coding facial movements, and providing detailed reports with insights.


Qualifications

  • FACS certification and advanced expertise in applying the system to analyse facial expressions
  • Strong detail-oriented analytical and observation skills
  • Proficiency in documenting and presenting analytical findings in both written and visual formats
  • Experience with AI-related projects or understanding of emotion and behaviour analysis is a plus
  • Excellent communication and time-management skills with the ability to meet contractual goals in a remote setting
  • High level of written English proficiency

title: Analista Contábil Sênior
description:
A Chilli Beans é a empresa jovem que investe em pessoas de mente aberta e interessadas em abraçar novos conceitos. Esta é uma de nossas maiores riquezas, é uma espécie de vírus que contagia levando o DNA da pimenta desde os funcionários do escritório central, franqueados, até o consumidor final.

Nosso ambiente é descolado, informal e com muita espontaneidade, a marca foi inspirada em música, moda e arte e os nossos valores são totalmente voltados à inovação, ousadia, diversidade e alegria.


E aí, está a fim de fazer parte do time mais apimentado da América Latina?

Então dê uma olhada na vaga abaixo? \o/


#VEMSERPIMENTA


O que você precisa para participar do processo seletivo?


  • Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência em apuração do Lucro real e obrigações acessórias.
  • Excel intermediário.
  • Experiência em atendimento à auditoria.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os departamentos para garantir a conformidade com as diretrizes operacionais e contábeis da empresa.
  • Responsável pela execução das atividades contábeis envolvendo classificação, análise, contabilidade em geral.
  • Análise e revisão de conciliações patrimoniais.
  • Realizar rotinas de fechamento mensal.
  • Controle e atualização de parcelamentos.
  • Acompanhamento de Inventário e movimentações de estoque.
  • Conciliação das contas de empréstimos x mapa.
  • Conciliação das contas de impostos diretos e indiretos.
  • Arrendamento (IFRS).
  • Apuração do lucro real.
  • Elaboração de obrigações acessórias (ECF/ECD).
  • Apoiar a preparação de demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas.
  • Propor e implementar iniciativas que visem a melhoria da eficiência e qualidade do processo.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde.
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Vale refeição.
  • Vale transporte ou vale combustível.
  • Estacionamento gratuito.
  • Wellhub.
  • PLR.


Nossos diferenciais:

  • Day off de aniversário.
  • Somos pet friendly, aqui seu pet é super bem vindo.
  • Massagem semanal.
  • Até 70% de desconto nos nossos produtos para você arrasar em qualquer ocasião.
  • Dress code livre – seja você e ouse no seu fashion style.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Node.JS Developer
description:
Node.JS Developer

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Contract

Responsibility

  • Develop and maintain server-side Node.js applications using the Express.js framework, OpenAPI, API Gateway, and Swagger specifications.
  • Work with a team of developers to design, implement, and test new features.
  • Optimize and troubleshoot existing applications to improve performance and reliability.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate server-side and client-side applications.
  • Mentor and coach junior developers on the team
  • Keep up to date with the latest Node.js, Express.js, OpenAPI, API Gateway, Swagger, and Jest developments.


Qualifications

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills


Bonus Points

  • Experience with cloud computing platforms such as AWS or Azure
  • Experience with container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Experience with leading and mentoring development teams

title: Analista de Cadastro em Marketplace
description:
Somos uma empresa especializada em estratégia, operação e crescimento de e-commerces e marketplaces, com forte atuação orientada a dados, tecnologia e performance.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Cadastro em Marketplace para atuar no processo de onboarding dos clientes, garantindo a correta integração de sistemas, cadastro de produtos e organização das informações nos canais de venda.

Essa posição exige atenção a detalhes, capacidade analítica e organização. Não buscamos alguém apenas rápido(a), mas alguém que tenha cuidado com processos, análise e qualidade das informações.


Responsabilidades

• Atuar no processo de onboarding de novos clientes após o fechamento comercial, organizando as etapas de cadastro e integração

• Realizar cadastro e atualização de produtos nos principais marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Magalu, Shopee, entre outros)

• Integrar hubs de anúncios com ERP, garantindo consistência entre sistemas e canais de venda

• Preencher fichas técnicas diretamente nos marketplaces, seguindo as diretrizes de cada plataforma

• Trabalhar com ferramentas como Magis5, Bling e sistemas de conciliação, apoiando a estruturação operacional das contas

• Organizar e tratar dados em Excel e Google Sheets para controle e atualização de cadastros

• Monitorar possíveis inconsistências entre sistemas, anúncios e produtos cadastrados

• Participar das rotinas diárias com o time (daily meetings) para alinhamento das demandas e prioridades

• Atuar de forma resolutiva, acompanhando a lista de demandas priorizadas pela liderança da área


Requisitos

• Excel intermediário

• Experiência com cadastro de produtos ou operações em marketplaces

• Organização, atenção a detalhes e senso de responsabilidade

• Perfil proativo, curioso e com vontade de aprender

• Facilidade para trabalhar com processos estruturados e demandas simultâneas


Diferenciais

• Experiência com hubs de integração (Magis5, Anymarket, Tray ou similares)

• Vivência em operações multicanal e e-commerce

• Conhecimento de diferentes marketplaces

• Experiência com ERP Bling ou sistemas de conciliação


O que oferecemos

• Remuneração de R$ 3.000,00 (PJ)

• Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo

• Oportunidade de aprendizado contínuo em operação de marketplaces

• Atuação próxima a projetos reais de crescimento dos clientes


Modelo de trabalho

• 100% remoto

• Contratação PJ

• Participação em alinhamentos diários com o time

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Build the infrastructure powering the future of lending.

Hitch is building the software platform behind the next generation of digital mortgage origination.

We power HELOC, DSCR, and Non-QM lending for some of the leading mortgage lenders in the U.S. — helping entrepreneurs access capital, enabling real estate investors to scale portfolios, and modernizing an industry that still runs on legacy infrastructure.


  • Non-QM → mortgages designed for entrepreneurs and non-traditional income
  • HELOC → home equity lending
  • DSCR → investor loans based on rental income


Our white-label platform sits at the center of complex enterprise implementations, compliance workflows, and mission-critical integrations with lender systems like Encompass.

We’re growing fast and need a Technical Program Manager who can bring structure, speed, and reliability to our delivery engine.

If you’re an execution machine who thrives in high-ownership startup environments, this role is for you.


What You’ll Own

You will drive delivery across enterprise client programs from kickoff to production.

  • Own implementation timelines and delivery schedules
  • Coordinate engineering, product, design, and operations dependencies
  • Manage third-party vendors and system integrations
  • Run UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and release readiness processes
  • Identify risks early and unblock teams quickly
  • Improve delivery predictability and execution velocity
  • Drive successful client launches and platform rollouts
  • Build scalable program management processes as we grow

This is a high-impact role working directly with leadership and enterprise customers.


What We’re Looking For
  • 4+ years in Technical Program Management, Implementation Management, or similar roles
  • Experience working closely with software engineering teams
  • Strong understanding of SaaS delivery and release cycles
  • Experience managing vendors or complex integrations
  • Highly organized, detail-obsessed, and execution-driven
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving startup environments
  • Strong communicator who drives accountability


Strong bonus if you have:

  • Fintech or mortgage experience
  • Enterprise SaaS implementation experience
  • Experience running UAT programs
  • Familiarity with Linear, Jira, or similar tools


Why Hitch
  • Direct ownership and massive impact
  • Work with leading non-QM mortgage lenders
  • Solve hard infrastructure problems in a massive market
  • High growth startup with real enterprise traction
  • Build systems that scale nationally


If you love turning complexity into execution and want to help modernize lending infrastructure, we want to talk.﻿

  • Apply or message us directly.

title: Lead Application Support Engineer
description:
MUST BE LOCATED IN BRAZIL


Position: Lead App Support Engineer – Sales Platform

Duration: 12-month Contract

Hours: 8 – 5PM EST

Pay Rate: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years in Production Support, SRE, or Application Operations
  • Strong debugging skills with Node.js and React/Angular
  • Experience with MongoDB and SQL Server
  • Familiarity with APM, logging, and monitoring tools
  • Strong communication skills and ability to lead incident resolution


Plusses:

  • Experience with Ionic mobile or hybrid applications
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow IMT & RCA workflows
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes and pipelines


Day to Day:

  • Monitor production applications to ensure stability, performance, and availability
  • Lead and participate in incident triage, troubleshooting, and resolution
  • Analyze system failures and apply break‑fix code or configuration changes as needed
  • Validate fixes in lower environments and coordinate with engineering for long‑term solutions
  • Perform proactive health checks, performance tuning, and reliability improvements
  • Support release activities and ensure smooth and compliant deployments
  • Provide clear communication and reporting to stakeholders during and after incidents


Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking a Lead App Support Engineer to support a large health insurance client of ours. The Application Support Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of core enterprise applications. The engineer will lead incident response efforts, perform proactive monitoring, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement break‑fix solutions to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence. This role also partners closely with development, QA, and infrastructure teams to drive continuous improvement and maintain operational excellence. Strong analytical skills, technical depth, and clear communication are essential to success.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Incident Management & On‑Call: Lead rapid incident response, drive MTTA/MTTR improvements, and coordinate multi‑team engagements
  • Monitoring, Observability & Reliability: Maintain and enhance dashboards, alerts, and performance indicators
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Management: Conduct deep‑dive analysis, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions
  • Break‑Fix Implementation: Diagnose issues, develop and deploy break‑fix solutions, validate changes, and ensure stable production operation
  • Change & Release Support: Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams for deployments, validations, and post‑release monitoring
  • Communication & Reporting: Provide status updates, incident summaries, and performance reporting to leadership and stakeholders
  • Governance & Best Practices: Adhere to operational standards, documentation requirements, and continuous improvement frameworks

Insight Global is seeking a Lead App Support Engineer to support a large health insurance client of ours. The Application Support Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of core enterprise applications. The engineer will lead incident response efforts, perform proactive monitoring, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement break‑fix solutions to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence. This role also partners closely with development, QA, and infrastructure teams to drive continuous improvement and maintain operational excellence. Strong analytical skills, technical depth, and clear communication are essential to success.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Incident Management & On‑Call: Lead rapid incident response, drive MTTA/MTTR improvements, and coordinate multi‑team engagements
  • Monitoring, Observability & Reliability: Maintain and enhance dashboards, alerts, and performance indicators
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Management: Conduct deep‑dive analysis, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions
  • Break‑Fix Implementation: Diagnose issues, develop and deploy break‑fix solutions, validate changes, and ensure stable production operation
  • Change & Release Support: Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams for deployments, validations, and post‑release monitoring
  • Communication & Reporting: Provide status updates, incident summaries, and performance reporting to leadership and stakeholders
  • Governance & Best Practices: Adhere to operational standards, documentation requirements, and continuous improvement frameworks

title: Engenheiro de Soluções
description:
Descrição

O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da GoodWe desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da GoodWe no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da GoodWe. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a GoodWe em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
  • Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
  • Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
  • Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
  • Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
  • Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
  • Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
  • Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
  • Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
  • Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
  • Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
  • Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
  • Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
  • Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
  • Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
  • Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
  • Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
  • Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
  • Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.


Habilidades Requeridas

  • Proficiência em mandarim
  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
  • Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
  • Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
  • Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
  • Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
  • Excelentes conhecimentos em AutoCAD e PVSyst;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
  • Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
  • Conhecimento avançado em MS PowerPoint;
  • Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
  • Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.


Atributos

  • Proatividade;
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
  • Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
  • Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Multitarefa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
  • Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
Altimetrik is a leading digital business enablement company. Our agile professionals and engineering teams craft innovative solutions that drive transformation and growth for businesses worldwide.


Are you ready to join an exceptional team? This is your opportunity to elevate your career with Altimetrik.


We are looking for a Senior Python Developer (Contractor) to join a high-impact environment, working on cloud-native, backend-oriented products within modern distributed systems.

Modality: Remote

️ English level: Advanced (B2/C1)

Position type: Full-time — Professional Services Contract


Responsibilities

• Develop, build, and optimize Python-based backend services

• Create and maintain scalable APIs using Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django)

• Work with AWS cloud services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EKS, EC2, S3)

• Design resilient software components for distributed systems

• Implement containerized solutions using Docker & Kubernetes

• Write unit tests and maintain high standards of code quality

• Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver cloud-native solutions


Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in Python development

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3, EKS, EC2)

• Experience with Django and Flask

• Experience building APIs using FastAPI

• Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes

• Experience writing self-testing code (unit tests)

• Ability to design scalable, resilient components in distributed architectures

• Advanced English (B2/C1)


What We Offer

Since this role is under a Professional Services Contractor model , compensation and benefits will be aligned accordingly for Brazil, ensuring competitive market rates.


If you enjoy working on backend systems, cloud technologies, distributed architectures, and solving real technical challenges, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply now and be part of the change!

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Tech Lead | Marketplace
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead para evoluir um Marketplace digital de plataforma, com impacto direto na expansão do ecossistema, na geração de valor e na experiência dos clientes.

O desafio envolve evoluir uma plataforma de produtos digitais integrada, escalável e orientada a crescimento. Como Tech Lead, você terá papel central em transformar visão de produto em soluções técnicas sustentáveis e prontas para escala.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução de produtos de plataforma, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura, equilibrando integração, autonomia e experiência unificada.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e contribuir hands-on com o time.
  • Trabalhar próximo a produto e stakeholders, apoiando decisões e trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, promovendo boas práticas e excelência técnica.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção de produtos digitais de plataforma, como marketplaces, portais ou ecossistemas orientados a crescimento (PQL / PLG).
  • Forte base em arquitetura de software e sistemas distribuídos, aplicando Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Vivência sólida em backend distribuído, com microserviços em Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot), APIs REST e contratos OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e comunicação assíncrona, garantindo resiliência e consistência entre serviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL) e modelagem orientada a domínio.
  • Vivência com observabilidade em sistemas distribuídos, incluindo métricas e rastreamento ponta a ponta.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud, com CI/CD, containers e múltiplos ambientes.
  • Conhecimento de frontend moderno, incluindo React e TypeScript.
  • Atuação como Tech Lead, definindo padrões técnicos e orientando times de engenharia.
  • Experiência prévia com marketplaces digitais ou plataformas de monetização.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade avançada, performance e escalabilidade
  • Atuação em produtos com integrações complexas e múltiplos domínios de negócio.


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT


BENEFÍCIOS

Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Cold-Formed Steel Framing BIM Specialist (MWF)
description:
ENG has evolved, expanded and become increasingly complex, but continues to be dedicated to being a high-growth, well-run, profitable business with employees and contractors located throughout the world.

A modeler, as its very name says, is the one who models the buildings in Revit or similar programs. Depending on their seniority or expertise, they can model one or more disciplines. Modelers at ENG must also understand and review discipline specifications, project manuals, and submittals (Quality Analysis), and be able to read the design information provided by our clients to create accurate and constructible BIM models.

Mandatory Requirements:

  • An Upper Intermediate level of English is an absolute must.
  • Civil Engineering degree (Framing background).
  • +3 years of experience in BIM MEP.
  • Broad knowledge of Revit & Navisworks.

Desirable Requirements:

  • MWF software knowledge.
  • Experience in US-based projects.


Company Culture and Values

  • Candor: We value honesty, openness, and sincerity in all interactions.
  • Accountability: We take ownership and are committed to delivering high-quality work on time.
  • Win-Win Mentality: We strive for mutual success in all business relationships.


Growth Opportunities

As part of our commitment to your career progression, we offer:

  • Career Development Programs.
  • Internal Mobility.
  • Performance-Based Promotions.
  • Leadership Opportunities.
  • Project Diversity.

Why join us? Explore our amazing benefits! ✨

Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space.

Unlimited PTO: Recharge with flexible paid time off when you need it.

Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, fun challenges and team celebrations.

Continuous Learning: Programs to develop your technical and soft skills.

Work Equipment to Keep You Productive: We provide everything you need to create the perfect workspace.

Tech & Office Allowances: Upgrade your workspace with our one-time allowances. With \"Pimp up your Devices,\" and “Home Office set up allowance” you can upgrade gadgets for a better experience.

Monthly Internet Allowance: Stay connected with a monthly allowance for internet and expenses.

Highly Competitive Compensation Package: Includes both fixed and variable payments, all processed in our local currency, USD.

title: Mendix Developer Senior | LowCode
description:
Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior – Mendix para liderar projetos estratégicos e ser referência técnica no time. Se você tem carreira sólida em tecnologia, experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix e gosta de compartilhar conhecimento, essa oportunidade é para você!


O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Mendix, garantindo qualidade e integração.
  • Apoiar decisões de arquitetura e orientar o time em melhores práticas.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, com foco em performance e escalabilidade.
  • Ser referência técnica, promovendo aprendizado e evolução contínua.


Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix .
  • Conhecimento em integração via APIs , modelagem de dados e versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência com Mendix Studio Pro , Developer Portal e práticas low-code.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Perfil colaborativo e capacidade de orientar equipes.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura escalável , microsserviços e mensageria.
  • Conhecimento em Docker/Kubernetes , práticas DevOps e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, Azure) e integração com serviços externos.
  • Base sólida em Java, JavaScript e princípios S.O.L.I.D.



O que oferecemos:


Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.


Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!


O time está te esperando, vamos nessa?

title: Analista Contábil Fiscal
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em um grupo eleito como a 86ª startup mais promissora do Brasil ?


A Conface Contabilidade , empresa da Dreamland Holding (que também inclui a Dream Success), está em busca de um(a) Analista Contábil Fiscal para integrar o time.


Essa é uma oportunidade para contadores que desejam crescer em uma contabilidade reconhecida pelo modelo inovador e por um atendimento verdadeiramente humanizado .


Para nós, contabilidade não é apenas enviar tributos para o cliente todos os meses. É fazer parte da vida do empreendedor , ajudando-o a crescer e tomar decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades (Fiscal & Contábil)


  • Apuração de impostos : ISS, ICMS, IPI, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
  • Obrigações acessórias : EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD , ECF, DCTF, EFD-Reinf e DEFIS (e DIRF quando exigida pela legislação vigente).
  • Acompanhamento das mudanças do IVA (Imposto sobre Valor Adicionado) que passam a vigorar a partir do próximo ano.
  • Fechamento contábil autônomo : conciliações, provisões, classificação contábil, balancetes, Balanço e DRE .
  • Relatórios gerenciais e indicadores das empresas da carteira.
  • Atendimento consultivo a clientes para dúvidas técnicas (fiscal e contábil).
  • Demais atividades inerentes ao cargo.


Requisitos


  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (concluída ou em andamento).
  • CRC ativo (obrigatório e deve constar no currículo enviado para conferência ).
  • Experiência anterior na função fiscal/contábil em escritório de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel ).
  • Sistema Domínio : conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.


Nossa cultura


Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega .

Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados , mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento .


Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce.


Benefícios


  • Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
  • Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses , conforme seu desempenho.
  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$600 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.


Como se candidatar


Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado .

É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.


Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).


Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Fev/26.


Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: TechOps Specialist (HL7 Integration)
description:
TechOps (HL7 Integration)


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing healthcare SaaS organization, is seeking a Technical Operations Specialist to support post-sales technical implementations and system integrations.

This role is responsible for configuring and deploying HL7 interfaces within client environments, ensuring secure and accurate data connectivity between the SaaS platform and customer systems. The ideal candidate understands healthcare data workflows, integration standards, and how to work cross-functionally with client IT teams to enable seamless interoperability.

This is a post-sales, client-facing technical role that blends implementation, troubleshooting, and systems integration.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in healthcare IT, technical operations, or systems integration
  • Direct experience working with HL7 interfaces (v2.x preferred)
  • Experience connecting SaaS platforms to EHR or clinical systems
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data structures and workflows
  • Experience working with APIs, endpoints, or secure data transmission protocols
  • Ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently
  • Strong communication skills when working with client IT teams


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within a healthcare SaaS organization
  • Familiarity with EHR systems
  • Experience with interface engines
  • Knowledge of HIPAA-compliant data handling practices


Key Responsibilities


Post-Sales Implementation Support

  • Lead technical onboarding activities following customer contract execution
  • Configure and deploy HL7 interfaces within client instances
  • Coordinate with client IT and EHR teams to establish secure data connections
  • Ensure accurate mapping of inbound and outbound data fields

HL7 & Data Integration

  • Build, configure, and validate HL7 message interfaces
  • Support integration between the SaaS platform and client EHR or clinical systems
  • Troubleshoot data transmission errors and interface failures
  • Validate endpoint connectivity and message formatting

Client Collaboration

  • Serve as technical point of contact during implementation
  • Communicate integration requirements clearly to client technical stakeholders
  • Assist in diagnosing and resolving integration-related issues
  • Support go-live and stabilization efforts

System & Workflow Optimization

  • Monitor integration performance and data accuracy
  • Improve documentation around interface setup and troubleshooting
  • Contribute to process improvements within the technical operations function

Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing healthcare SaaS organization, is seeking a Technical Operations Specialist to support post-sales technical implementations and system integrations.

This role is responsible for configuring and deploying HL7 interfaces within client environments, ensuring secure and accurate data connectivity between the SaaS platform and customer systems. The ideal candidate understands healthcare data workflows, integration standards, and how to work cross-functionally with client IT teams to enable seamless interoperability.

This is a post-sales, client-facing technical role that blends implementation, troubleshooting, and systems integration.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in healthcare IT, technical operations, or systems integration
  • Direct experience working with HL7 interfaces (v2.x preferred)
  • Experience connecting SaaS platforms to EHR or clinical systems
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data structures and workflows
  • Experience working with APIs, endpoints, or secure data transmission protocols
  • Ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently
  • Strong communication skills when working with client IT teams


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within a healthcare SaaS organization
  • Familiarity with EHR systems
  • Experience with interface engines
  • Knowledge of HIPAA-compliant data handling practices


Key Responsibilities


Post-Sales Implementation Support

  • Lead technical onboarding activities following customer contract execution
  • Configure and deploy HL7 interfaces within client instances
  • Coordinate with client IT and EHR teams to establish secure data connections
  • Ensure accurate mapping of inbound and outbound data fields

HL7 & Data Integration

  • Build, configure, and validate HL7 message interfaces
  • Support integration between the SaaS platform and client EHR or clinical systems
  • Troubleshoot data transmission errors and interface failures
  • Validate endpoint connectivity and message formatting

Client Collaboration

  • Serve as technical point of contact during implementation
  • Communicate integration requirements clearly to client technical stakeholders
  • Assist in diagnosing and resolving integration-related issues
  • Support go-live and stabilization efforts

System & Workflow Optimization

  • Monitor integration performance and data accuracy
  • Improve documentation around interface setup and troubleshooting
  • Contribute to process improvements within the technical operations function

title: SQL Architect
description:
Job Title: Solution Architect / Technical Architect

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities:

• We are seeking a seasoned Solution Architect / Technical Architect with 15+ years of IT experience, including 10+ years in public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure.

• Conduct AS-IS assessments of applications, design target state architectures, and obtain approvals from client architecture review boards.

• Drive cloud solutioning activities for large-scale Azure migrations and transformations.

• Design and build Azure Landing Zones, ensuring alignment with business, application, and infrastructure strategies.

• Provide Azure target architecture diagrams (HLD & LLD), BoM pricing, and licensing details.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains to deliver enterprise-grade solutions.

• Troubleshoot Azure and Windows environments, including processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory issues.

• Ensure projects meet stakeholder expectations, value-for-money considerations, and governance requirements.


Must Have Skills:

✔ Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM)

✔ Architecture frameworks and solution design expertise

✔ Cloud migration and transformation experience (on-prem to public cloud)

✔ Azure Landing Zone design and implementation

✔ Strong troubleshooting skills in Azure & Windows environments

✔ Experience across multiple industry domains (banking, healthcare, insurance)

✔ Stakeholder management and documentation (HLD, LLD, approvals, governance)


Good to Have:

  • Certifications: AZ-305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ-104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator)
  • Secondary Skills: Infrastructure/data storage design, business continuity/DR solutions, identity/governance/monitoring solutions
  • Tools: Project management tools (ADO), knowledge of pricing/licensing models


Apply today or share profiles at

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Senior Go Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts.


Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

title: Desenvolvedor Java com AWS
description:
Desenvolvedor Java com AWS


Local: atuação remota

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Nível: Pleno


Sobre a Vaga:

Como Desenvolvedor Java com AWS, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações escaláveis e eficientes na nuvem. Você trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções que atendam às necessidades dos nossos clientes e do negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em Java, garantindo alta qualidade e desempenho.

- Projetar e implementar soluções utilizando Amazon Web Services (AWS), como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda.

- Colaborar com equipes de design e produto para definir requisitos e especificações das aplicações.

- Participar de revisões de código e garantir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

- Implementar e manter processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).

- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho e segurança nas aplicações.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando Java.

- Conhecimento prático em AWS e serviços relacionados.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

- Experiência em frameworks Java, como Spring ou Hibernate.

- Compreensão de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil e metodologias DevOps.

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e colaborar de forma eficaz.

- Conhecimento de ambientes de governança do seguimento financeiro.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento frontend (ex.: React, Angular) é um diferencial.
