title: Tech Lead Node.JS
description:
Responsabilidades


Liderança Técnica: Orientar a equipe de desenvolvimento, definir padrões e melhores práticas, garantindo a qualidade do código e a implementação de soluções eficientes.

Arquitetura e Design: Participar do design e da arquitetura de sistemas, definindo a estrutura do código, as tecnologias a serem utilizadas e a organização do projeto.

Facilitação do Scrum: Facilitar as cerimônias Scrum (planning, daily, review e retrospectiva), assegurar o cumprimento do processo, remover impedimentos e promover a colaboração e a comunicação do time.

Mentoria e Treinamento: Mentorar e apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos membros da equipe, compartilhando conhecimento e incentivando o aprendizado contínuo.

Gerenciamento de Riscos: Identificar e analisar riscos técnicos do projeto, propor planos de mitigação e garantir a segurança e a estabilidade do sistema.


Requisitos Técnicos


Linguagens de Programação: Domínio profundo de linguagens relevantes para o projeto, com foco em Node.js.

Arquitetura de Software: Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura, frameworks e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de sistemas.

Banco de Dados: Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, incluindo design, modelagem e otimização de queries.

Versionamento de Código: Domínio de ferramentas como Git, incluindo uso de branches, merges, pull requests e workflows.


Formação e Experiência

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins.

Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica e desenvolvimento de software.

Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento (SOLID, Clean Code).

Desejável certificações em áreas como gerenciamento de projetos, frameworks de desenvolvimento ou linguagens de programação.

Inglês técnico para leitura e escrita.

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.


For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Design Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for someone with a sharp eye for aesthetics who can catch the hottest visual styles on campus and help our products look and feel right for local users.


What You’ll Do:

● Capture Visual Trends: Continuously analyze the aesthetic preferences and popular styles among local students to guide product design.

● Localize Visuals: Help adjust marketing materials visually (like layout and cultural fit) and create visuals that align with local aesthetics.

● Be a design critic: Review our products (and competitors') from a user’s perspective identify visual or experience flaws, and give practical feedback.


We Hope You Are:

● Have a keen eye: naturally notice design, imagery, and visual trends in everyday life and social media; are interested in youth culture and what’s trending locally.

● Think like a visual detective: not just see if something looks good—but ask why it’s designed in that way and how it could be better.

● Care about user experience: pay attention to how visuals affect usability and enjoy comparing product designs critically.


Bonus Points If You Have:

● Extensive knowledge of local visual product usage habits gained from living in regions like North America, Latam America, or East/Southeast Asia.

● A background in design, art, visual communication, or digital media arts.

● Have hands-on experience in graphic design, UI/UX, video editing, or photography.

● Are part of design clubs, competitions, or create visual content yourself.


What You’ll Get:

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design


Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: UGC Content Creator (Freelance)
description:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.


Role Overview

Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.

Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.

Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.

Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.

Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.

Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.


Candidate Profile

Strong interest in TikTok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.

Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).

Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.

Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.

Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.

Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.

English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.


Compensation

Per-Video Payment Model: You’ll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter arquiteturas frontend escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance
  • Definir e implementar padrões e melhores práticas para pipelines de CI/CD e ferramentas de frontend
  • Garantir performance, otimização e resiliência de aplicações web
  • Implementar estratégias de monitoramento, observabilidade e resolução eficiente de incidentes

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java e Agentes de IA II
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java com experiência em engenharia de software, mentalidade DevOps e interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções com agentes de IA, automação inteligente e integrações com modelos de linguagem (LLMs), no projeto BSS, do ICC SOFT.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços e aplicações em Java, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e segurança;
  • Construir, testar e implantar agentes de IA para automação de processos de negócio;
  • Integrar LLMs com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços externos e ferramentas corporativas;
  • Contribuir para pipelines de RAG, mecanismos de memória e recuperação eficiente de contexto;
  • Garantir a confiabilidade dos fluxos envolvendo agentes de IA e automações inteligentes;
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, integração e funcionais);
  • Escrever testes específicos para componentes agentic AI;
  • Atuar em troubleshooting de ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD para build, teste e deploy contínuo;
  • Utilizar conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes) para implantações;
  • Assegurar observabilidade e monitoramento de workflows agentic AI;
  • Participar de code reviews, sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento e cerimônias ágeis;
  • Prestar suporte técnico e atuar como referência para demandas de média e alta complexidade;
  • Revisar e manter documentação detalhada de arquitetura, componentes, integrações e processos de deploy;
  • Registrar decisões técnicas e padrões adotados para uso de IA e automação.



Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou correlatos;


Experiência em:

  • Desenvolvimento Java e POO,
  • Microsserviços e APIs REST,
  • Automação de testes (unitários, integração ou funcionais),
  • Ferramentas GIT,
  • LLMs e frameworks de IA (ex: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel);


Domínio em Java e Python

  • Node.js ou outra linguagem é diferencial;


Conhecimento em bancos de dados (SQL Server, Oracle, Cassandra ou similares);


Noções de vetores, embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais;

title: Service Technician
description:
Description

The Service Technician should be responsible to provide Aftersales support for Brazil, working from home. He/she is responsible for providing remote support, technical training for partners and on-site service when necessary. The person should be available for business trips and understand the electric and photovoltaic (solar) standards and requirements for Brazil.


Please do not apply if you do not meet the requirements!


Responsibilities

  • Handle general inquires for technical support and after sales related activities;
  • Training partners to provide daily technical support to customers over phone line, email, or face to face;
  • Solve / handle technical escalations from the customers;
  • Provide technical advice for local distributors, installers and end users;
  • Provide minor on-site inspection, commissioning, troubleshooting and replacement of defectives products, with appointments of customers in advance;
  • Keep track of in-out of replacements units;
  • Perform firmware upgrading and minor reworks in hardware locally when necessary;
  • Maintain frequent communication with management staff in Brazil;
  • Maintain a good communication with Level 2 engineers based in HQ office, in China;
  • Attend exhibitions and marketing events and introduce products and solutions;
  • Submit the related reports and documents to supervisor every week;
  • Be available during work hours, from Monday-Friday, between 8-12h and 13:30-18h.


Required Skills

  • Intermediate Chinese for speaking and writring;
  • Technical degree in electricity, Photovoltaics, Renewable Energy or other comparable course;
  • Advanced knowledge of PV Inverters (on-grid and storage);
  • At least 1 year of experience with PV inverters;
  • Experience with DG (Distributed Generation);
  • Basic knowledge in sizing electrical circuits, PV arrangement, protection circuits, and interpretation of electrical diagrams;
  • Knowledge about Brazilian regulation on PV;
  • MS Office.
  • English speaking


Optional Skills (If you have them, it’s a Plus!)

  • Spanish speaking;
  • Experience with PV Large Utility-Scale;
  • Experience with lead-acid and lithium batteries for PV storage systems;
  • Zendesk experience;
  • NeoCRM experience.


Attributions

  • Excellent organization skills with the ability to quickly assess priorities;
  • Proactivity, sense of urgency, team work;
  • Independence (work without direct supervision);
  • Availability for business trips in Brazil.

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

title: Analista de Suporte Pleno – SRE/Cloud
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Buscamos um(a) Analista de Suporte Pleno com foco em SRE e Cloud para atuar na sustentação, evolução e confiabilidade de ambientes críticos em nuvem. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo na estabilidade de sistemas produtivos, atuando desde o monitoramento e automação até a análise e resolução de incidentes, sempre em parceria com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de ambientes Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure e/ou Google Cloud Platform)
  • Administrar e dar suporte a clusters Kubernetes
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e alertas
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes, realizando troubleshooting em ambientes produtivos
  • Apoiar na definição, acompanhamento e cumprimento de SLAs
  • Automatizar processos operacionais como deploys, rotinas, escalabilidade e correções
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança
  • Propor melhorias contínuas visando maior resiliência, performance e redução de incidentes
  • Atuar em regime de plantão conforme escala 24x7


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos atuando com suporte, SRE, Cloud ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prática com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Kubernetes e containers (Docker)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, New Relic, Elastic, Dynatrace ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux
  • Experiência com troubleshooting de aplicações e infraestrutura
  • Noções de redes, balanceamento de carga e alta disponibilidade
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em plantões em escala 24x7
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e expor ideias


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD
  • Vivência com práticas e cultura DevOps
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Perfil analítico, proativo, com senso de dono e foco em melhoria contínua
  • Capacidade de lidar com incidentes e situações críticas de forma estruturada


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de suporte SRE e Cloud para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Engenheiro Full Stack Sênior (React & Golang)
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro Full Stack Sênior com sólida experiência em React e Golang

para se juntar ao nosso time. Este profissional será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter

aplicações web de ponta a ponta, utilizando tecnologias modernas, com foco em desempenho,

escalabilidade e qualidade de código. Você atuará em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares,

participando ativamente de decisões técnicas e de arquitetura, contribuindo para a evolução

contínua da plataforma e construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e utilizadas em ambientes

reais e críticos.


Diferenciais


• Experiência com livestreaming de vídeo ou sistemas de streaming

• Conhecimento em WebSockets e/ou WebRTC

• Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços

• Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)

• Conhecimento em observabilidade (logs, métricas e tracing)


Stack Tecnológica

• Back-end: Golang

• Front-end: ReactJS / Polymer

• Banco de dados: PostgreSQL

• Mensageria: RabbitMQ

• Infraestrutura: Cloud (Azure)

• Containers: Docker

• Versionamento: Git

• Metodologia: Ágil (Scrum / Kanban)


Perfil que Buscamos

• Perfil sênior, hands-on e proativo

• Forte capacidade de comunicação

• Autonomia para tomada de decisões técnicas

• Compromisso com qualidade e boas práticas

• Mentalidade de dono (ownership)

title: Analista de Revenue Operations (RevOps)
description:
Na Jusfy, estamos fortalecendo nossa área de Business Operations com foco em eficiência, dados e impacto. Buscamos um(a) Analista de RevOps estratégico(a), analítico(a) e articulador(a), capaz de garantir a fluidez e integração da jornada de receita — do marketing ao pós-venda — e impulsionar nosso crescimento sustentável.

Como Analista de Revenue Operations, você será parte integrante do time de BizOps, atuando como elo entre as áreas comerciais, marketing, customer success e operações. Sua visão holística e habilidades analíticas serão essenciais para estruturar processos, definir métricas e conduzir projetos de alto impacto.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear, estruturar e otimizar processos de receita (pré e pós-venda), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Atuar com forte viés analítico, construindo análises e dashboards para orientar decisões estratégicas de crescimento e performance.
  • Ser o guardião dos dados e KPIs de receita, garantindo consistência e clareza sobre métricas como: CAC, LTV, MRR, churn, conversão por etapa, produtividade comercial, NRR e outras.

  • Conduzir projetos de melhoria e automação dos processos comerciais e de CS, em parceria com as áreas envolvidas.
  • Apoiar previsibilidade e planejamento de receita (forecast, pipeline health, análise de funil).
  • Ser referência em dados e insights para os times de Vendas, CS, Marketing e Produto.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Revenue Operations, Business Operations, Sales Ops ou CS Ops.
  • Domínio de métricas SaaS (CAC, LTV, MRR, churn, etc.).
  • Vivência com gestão de CRM (preferencialmente HubSpot).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado e experiência com análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio, Metabase, Power BI, etc.).
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos, com capacidade de planejar, executar e monitorar iniciativas de melhoria de processos.
  • Habilidade para atuar de forma autônoma, com pensamento estruturado e foco em resultados.
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de colaboração com múltiplas áreas.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com planejamento comercial, forecast e produtividade de vendas.

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Vaga desenvolvedor Backend Júnior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Construir e configurar dashboards seguindo as especificações de escopo;
  • Desenvolver consultas em banco de dados para alimentar os indicadores e gráficos dos painéis;
  • Realizar a validação técnica dos dados para garantir a integridade das informações apresentadas;
  • Elaborar documentações e textos de auxílio dentro dos painéis para orientar os usuários;
  • Realizar manutenções, correções e atualizações em dashboards já existentes;
  • Interagir com a equipe interna para alinhamento de demandas.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou cursando em áreas relacionadas a TI;
  • Conhecimento em linguagem SQL , com foco em DQL (capacidade de construir consultas com SELECT, JOINs, filtros e agrupamentos );
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com forte atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação escrita para elaboração de documentações técnicas.



Será um diferencial!

  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia com o banco de dados PostgreSQL ;
  • Conhecimento básico de HTML;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente ou suporte técnico.



Por que #VemParaSyonet? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente!

title: Senior SAP Consultant
description:
Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant (Remote, Brazil)


We are looking for a Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant to join a global project, working 100 percent remotely from Brazil . This role is for someone with real hands on experience in SAP Fieldglass implementations , not generic SAP consulting.


If you have worked deeply with Fieldglass CWM and SOW , understand Source to Pay , and are comfortable working directly with clients, this role is for you.


What You Will Do

  • Work on SAP Fieldglass implementation and rollout projects
  • Configure and support Contingent Workforce Management (CWM) and Statement of Work (SOW) processes
  • Collaborate with procurement, HR, finance, and IT stakeholders
  • Support integrations between SAP Fieldglass and SAP Ariba, SAP S 4HANA, or SAP ECC
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into Fieldglass configuration
  • Identify risks early and propose clear mitigation actions
  • Support testing, defect resolution, and UAT activities using JIRA
  • Ensure high quality delivery with strong focus on customer satisfaction

Mandatory Experience

  • 6 or more years of hands on experience with SAP Fieldglass
  • Proven experience in Fieldglass implementation or rollout projects
  • Strong configuration experience in CWM and SOW
  • Solid understanding of Source to Pay processes
  • Experience integrating Fieldglass with SAP Ariba and SAP S 4HANA or SAP ECC
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP SuccessFactors
  • Previous work in global or multi country projects
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills

Work Setup

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work model: 100 percent remote
  • Client interview required
  • English is mandatory for daily communication

Important

  • Resumes must be submitted in English
  • This role requires real SAP Fieldglass project experience
  • Candidates without Fieldglass hands on experience will not be considered

title: UX/UI Design E-commerce - Figma
description:
About the Company

We are a Shopify Premier Agency with an eight-year history of delivering e-commerce solutions for established consumer brands. Our focus is on creating high-performing digital storefronts by balancing aesthetic quality with technical performance. We are currently expanding our design department to work closely with our established engineering team.


The Role

We are seeking a UI/UX Designer who specializes in e-commerce. This role involves designing end-to-end shopping experiences that are both visually compelling and technically viable. You will be responsible for translating brand requirements into functional interfaces, ensuring that every design decision supports the broader goal of driving conversions and enhancing user experience.


Key Responsibilities
  • E-Commerce Design: Develop comprehensive UI/UX solutions for product pages, checkout flows, and landing pages tailored for Shopify-based brands.
  • Technical Collaboration: Partner with the engineering team throughout the project lifecycle to ensure designs are implemented accurately and efficiently.
  • Trend Analysis: Stay current with evolving e-commerce trends and UX best practices to provide informed recommendations to clients.
  • Prototyping & Handoff: Manage the transition from design to development, providing clear documentation and interactive prototypes.

    • Required Qualifications
    • E-Commerce Experience: A portfolio demonstrating previous work on websites that sell products, with a clear understanding of retail-specific UX.
    • Figma Proficiency: Expert-level knowledge of Figma is mandatory, including the use of components, auto-layout, and prototyping tools.
    • Bi-Lingual - Spanish and English
    • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with the product and engineering lifecycle; you should understand how design decisions impact front-end development.
    • U.S. Timezone Alignment: Ability to work standard U.S. business hours to facilitate real-time collaboration with the team and clients.

    • Benefits
    • Professional Development: We provide paid training and professional classes to support your career growth.
    • Paid Time Off: Comprehensive PTO policy to ensure work-life balance.
    • Stability: Join a structured team with nearly a decade of experience in the Shopify ecosystem.

title: Analista de Automação - CAWA (Remoto)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Automação de Workload especializado em CA Workload Automation (CAWA) com experiência em automação de processos e habilidades técnicas para gerenciar e otimizar workloads através da plataforma CAWA.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Gerenciamento de Workloads: Planejar, implementar e monitorar processos automatizados utilizando CAWA;
  • Análise de Performance: Executar análises contínuas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria na automação de tarefas;
  • Suporte Técnico: Fornecer suporte técnico e orientação para a equipe em relação a problemas relacionados ao CAWA;
  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em conjunto com outras equipes para garantir a integração eficaz de sistemas e processos;
  • Documentação: Criar e manter documentação técnica sobre processos e procedimentos de automação.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Formação: Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência com CA Workload Automation, com domínio nas funcionalidades da ferramenta;
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento em scripting (e.g., Python, Bash) e experiência com bancos de dados;
  • Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade para analisar problemas complexos e propor soluções eficazes.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de Dono;
  • Foco no Cliente.

title: Analista de BI e MIS Pleno
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista de BI & MIS Pleno com perfil analítico, visão estratégica e foco em otimização de processos, para atuar na estruturação, modelagem e automação de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e geração de insights para o negócio.


O(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados transacionais em informações estratégicas, apoiando a tomada de decisão por meio de relatórios e dashboards eficientes.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Otimizar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL) provenientes das ferramentas da empresa e/ou clientes;
  • Estruturar e armazenar dados utilizando técnicas de modelagem dimensional , visando escalabilidade e performance;
  • Desenvolver e manter relatórios e dashboards com foco em KPIs estratégicos;
  • Automatizar processos e rotinas de dados;
  • Interagir com clientes e áreas internas para entender necessidades de negócio e propor melhorias;
  • Garantir qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade das bases de dados.


Requisitos


Formação:

  • Ensino Superior cursando em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas .


Experiência:

  • Mínimo de 3 meses de experiência em BI e MIS .


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Power BI (básico a intermediário);
  • SQL Server (intermediário);
  • ETL (intermediário);
  • Lógica de programação;
  • Ferramentas de Business Analytics;
  • Integration Services;
  • Python será considerado diferencial.

title: Finance Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Finance & Operations Manager (Part-Time)

About the Company:

Our client is a fast-growing B2B software company providing enterprises, especially financial institutions, with a platform to accelerate innovation. The platform simplifies the discovery, validation, and scaling of vendors, tools, and data solutions, reducing the time, risk, and cost associated with adopting fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Finance & Operations Manager to work closely with the CFO and take ownership of day-to-day finance and selected operational responsibilities. This is a hands-on, number-two role within the finance function, ideal for someone who enjoys both detailed execution and contributing to strategic initiatives in a scaling environment. This position is part-time and fully remote.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and own the month-end close and bookkeeping processes.

• Consolidate multiple entities into a single, accurate set of accounts (essential requirement).

• Manage day-to-day accounts payable and receivable processes.

• Support the CFO with financial planning, KPI tracking, and preparation of investor materials.

• Maintain and update financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Support international expansion initiatives from a finance and compliance perspective.

• Assist with operational responsibilities, including contributing to SOC 2 and ISO certification processes.

• Identify process improvements across Finance and Operations and implement practical solutions.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

• Proven experience consolidating multiple entities into one set of accounts.

• Strong experience leading month-end close processes and managing bookkeeping.

• Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments.

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of reliability and diligence.

• Ability to work autonomously and balance multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience maintaining and updating financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Experience with cap table management software and compliance processes.

• Exposure to supporting audit, certification, or regulatory processes (e.g., SOC 2, ISO).

Personality:

• Hands-on and proactive, with a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfortable operating both at a detailed level and in strategic discussions.

• Flexible working style with strong organizational skills.

• Collaborative and adaptable in a scaling business environment.

Software & Tools:

• Accounting and bookkeeping software.

• Financial forecasting and cash flow modeling tools.

• Cap table management software.

• Compliance and certification tracking tools (SOC 2, ISO).

English Level:

C2

Schedule:

Part-Time UK Business Hours

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the finance function within a high-growth company.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

title: Account Executive Brazil
description:
Localização


Brasil (remoto)

Disponibilidade para reuniões presenciais estratégicas


Sobre a Cybervision


A Cybervision é uma plataforma moderna de PAM (Privileged Access Management), criada para empresas que precisam de segurança imediata, visibilidade total e controle real sobre acessos privilegiados. Nosso foco é entregar valor rápido, com implantação ágil, monitoramento ativo e abordagem orientada a risco e negócio.


 Responsabilidades

• Atuar na abertura de novos clientes no mercado brasileiro, com foco em médias e grandes empresas

• Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas: prospecção, diagnóstico, apresentação, negociação e fechamento

• Identificar dores reais relacionadas a acessos privilegiados, identidade, compliance e risco operacional

• Trabalhar de forma consultiva, traduzindo conceitos técnicos de cibersegurança em valor de negócio

• Atuar em conjunto com times de pré-vendas e engenharia para construção de propostas técnicas e comerciais

• Desenvolver e manter um pipeline previsível, com foco em resultados e recorrência

• Apoiar a construção da estratégia de entrada e posicionamento da Cybervision no Brasil

• Manter relacionamento próximo com decisores (CIO, CISO, CTO, Segurança, Infra e Risco)


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência comprovada como Account Executive ou Hunter B2B em tecnologia ou cibersegurança

• Domínio de conceitos de cibersegurança, especialmente:

• PAM (Privileged Access Management)

• IAM / Identity

• Acesso remoto seguro

title: Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.


Requirements:


- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

title: Stablecoin Operations Manager
description:
EUROPROP® Trading is a proprietary digital asset trading firm operating across global cryptocurrency markets. We combine institutional-grade risk controls, capital efficiency strategies, and high-performance infrastructure to manage and scale digital asset operations.


As stablecoins play a critical role in liquidity management, settlement flows, and cross-exchange capital deployment, we are expanding our operational leadership team. We are seeking a highly skilled Stablecoin Operations Manager to oversee stablecoin liquidity management, treasury flows, on-chain transfers, and counterparty coordination.

This is a strategic and operational role at the core of our capital infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee daily stablecoin treasury operations across multiple exchanges and blockchain networks.
  • Manage minting, redemption, transfers, and liquidity balancing of major stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI, etc.).
  • Monitor on-chain transactions, gas optimization, settlement timing, and network congestion risks.
  • Coordinate capital allocation between trading desks, custodians, and exchange accounts.
  • Implement operational risk controls, reconciliation procedures, and reporting systems.
  • Manage counterparty exposure and settlement processes with liquidity providers.
  • Ensure accurate internal reporting of stablecoin balances and transactional flows.


Requirements
  • Proven experience working with stablecoins in a trading, exchange, fintech, or crypto-native environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain networks (Ethereum, Tron, BSC, etc.) and on-chain settlement mechanics.
  • Experience managing large-scale treasury flows and liquidity operations.
  • High attention to detail and operational risk awareness.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fully remote structure.
  • Strong analytical and process-management skills.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


What We Offer
  • Annual salary: BRL 420,000–480,000, plus performance-based bonus structure.
  • Fully remote role within Brazil.
  • Direct involvement in managing large-scale digital asset liquidity operations.
  • Institutional-grade infrastructure and multi-exchange connectivity.
  • High-responsibility environment with measurable operational impact.
  • Long-term growth opportunity within a rapidly expanding digital asset trading firm.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Senior Software Developer (React.js / Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystem, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers having lead the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using TypeScript, React.js, and Node.js, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communications skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and modern JavaScript frameworks and libraries
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team in to tasks that can be accomplished inside of a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process
  • Communicates across and outside of team to answer questions, resolve issues, and access impacts to other teams of changes being made in their sprint team
  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager (GTM), or Tag Assistant (GTA)
  • Knowledge of SaaS environments and SDLC methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Roadmap Release)
  • Knowledge in Business Intelligence tools, ETL, or reporting


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people

title: Arquiteto de IA
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Selbetti, estamos mudando o mundo da tecnologia com soluções inovadoras! Nossa equipe é formada por criativos, pensadores fora da caixa e, claro, apaixonados por tecnologia. Se você está cansado do mesmo de sempre e procura um lugar onde possa brilhar, você está no lugar certo!


TODAS AS NOSSAS VAGAS ESTÃO ABERTAS PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e alta performance.
  • Atuar como referência técnica na definição de padrões de arquitetura, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e governança de modelos.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento, produto e negócio) para traduzir necessidades estratégicas em soluções técnicas robustas.
  • Liderar decisões arquiteturais relacionadas a cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP), definindo padrões de integração, automação e observabilidade.
  • Estruturar e implementar práticas de MLOps, incluindo versionamento, monitoramento e automação do ciclo de vida dos modelos.
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias, frameworks e abordagens de IA, propondo melhorias contínuas nas soluções e processos.
  • Garantir conformidade com diretrizes de segurança, privacidade, ética e governança aplicadas ao uso de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time em revisões de código, troubleshooting e otimização de performance.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Inteligência Artificial, Ciência de Dados ou Machine Learning.
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software e sistemas distribuídos;
  • Domínio de machine learning, deep learning e ciclo de vida de modelos de IA;
  • Experiência prática com linguagens como Python e frameworks de IA;
  • Conhecimento avançado em engenharia de dados e pipelines de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência com plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura escalável;
  • Conhecimento em MLOps, versionamento de modelos e automação de deploy;
  • Familiaridade com governança, ética e segurança aplicada à IA;
  • Inglês técnico avançado para leitura e comunicação profissional.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de modelos de IA relacionados à Engenharia Civil envolvendo AutoCAD. (Diferencial)

title: Media Technology Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: Media Technology Support Engineer

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract / FTE


Role Summary

Provide technical support for cloud-based media encoding, transcoding, and content delivery systems. Troubleshoot video, audio, and subtitle processing issues while ensuring platform

performance, quality, and reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support media encoding and transcoding workflows
  • Troubleshoot video, audio, subtitle, and content delivery issues
  • Work with cloud environments (AWS/Azure/Google Cloud)
  • Monitor and respond to tickets via JIRA and Slack
  • Create documentation and runbooks after RCA
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams


Mandatory Skills

  • Strong knowledge of video containers (MOV, MXF, MP4, MPEG-TS)
  • Understanding of codecs (H.264, H.265, ProRes, MPEG2, AAC, AC3)
  • Experience with subtitles/caption formats (SRT, TTML, SCC etc.)
  • Hands-on Linux or Windows Server experience
  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred)
  • JSON/XML editing and API usage
  • Experience in media/OTT/broadcast content supply chain


Experience

  • 3+ years in media technology, OTT, or video operations
  • Experience in cloud-based media workflows
